name: chat-task-list
title: Chat Task List
description: An agent's task list as the turn's progress (task list v2): a hairline box with a count-and-time header, ✓ ◐ ◌ ⊘ rows with reasons inside the row, folding on the chat motion. Data is the chat contract's data-tasklist payload.

meta.whenToUse: The data-tasklist part of an agent turn.
meta.whenNotToUse: A to-do list a person edits (Checkbox lists, Tasks).
